youtube_metadata.title: Google Project Suncatcher: Testing AI in Space #Shorts
youtube_metadata.description:
Google Research has unveiled "Project Suncatcher"—an experimental research prototype designed to test whether machine learning hardware can survive and operate in low Earth orbit.

In partnership with Planet Labs, Google integrated four Trillium TPUs (TPU v6e) onto a prototype satellite equipped with a 1-kilowatt solar array. In dawn-dusk Sun-Synchronous Orbit, panels capture up to 8x more annual solar energy than on Earth.
